title: Run release validation with the required local Firebase Auth emulator
body:
## Problem

[Cut release run 37869482322, prepare step 9](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37869482322/job/113624012903#step:9:1) failed on merged master `18aa7c0`: six Firebase integration tests stopped because the local Auth emulator was not running. The release validator invokes `test:integration` directly, while normal CI uses the emulator-wrapped `test:services`. This inherited gap remains after the separate stale-candidate fix in merged PR42 and iOS dependency fix in merged PR44.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Make release-source validation provision and stop the local demo Auth emulator around its required integration suite, reusing maintained test infrastructure and retaining PostgreSQL validation.
- Keep all authentication tests mandatory and fail closed on emulator startup or test failure. Use only local synthetic/demo identities; never production Firebase, real credentials or provider setup.
- Add a regression exercising the actual release validation command boundary so passing normal CI cannot conceal different release prerequisites. Demonstrate the original failure and corrected local emulated validation.
- Preserve candidate/source/CI guards, retirement evidence and release permissions. No real release rerun, candidate mutation, publication, EAS build, store submission, deployment or secret access.

## Implementation plan

Use a fresh isolated checkout of actual master; inspect the exact failed log and compare `scripts/release/candidate.ts`, package scripts and CI. Fix the smallest validation boundary, verify emulator lifecycle and failure propagation, and run affected maintained checks. Publish a focused draft follow-on PR with retained exact evidence and independent same-QA review. Original PR42, issue41 and their evidence remain closed/preserved.

## Implementing Codex task

Existing release owner: `01a11c57-01a2-71f9-b53f-cbdee7d9b02e`; dispatch pending. Preserve its original dirty PR42 checkout without committing or pushing it over current source. This issue is a scoped claim, not execution evidence.

## Implementing PR

Pending focused draft follow-on PR. Historical related work: [PR42](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/42), [issue41](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/issues/41), and [release orchestration issue27](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/issues/27).
